sentences.text: On 1.27, .spec.ordinals is an optional field that allows you to configure the integer ordinals assigned to each Pod and you must enable the StatefulSetStartOrdinal feature gate to use it.

citations.quote: You must enable the `StatefulSetStartOrdinal` feature gate to use this field

sentences.text: On 1.27, the start ordinal is set via .spec.ordinals.start and pods will be assigned ordinals from that start value up through start + .spec.replicas - 1.

On 1.31, .spec.ordinals is an optional field that allows you to configure the integer ordinals assigned to each Pod and the feature gate StatefulSetStartOrdinal is stable.
On 1.31, the start ordinal is set via .spec.ordinals.start and pods will be assigned ordinals from that start value up through start + .spec.replicas - 1.
